item.title: What's Been Cooking: December 2025 (Year In Review)
item.description: Here’s a quick recap of what our December, and our 2025, held for us, plus a look at what we’re excited about for the year ahead.

item.title: Pomegranate Mocktail
item.description: This 4-ingredient pomegranate mocktail combines pomegranate juice, cranberry rosemary simple syrup, lime juice, and ginger beer for an easy, bright, and refreshing non-alcoholic drink.

item.title: Buffalo Chicken Calzone
item.description: Make this savory buffalo chicken calzone for a comforting high protein dinner! One calzone serves 2 people perfectly - so you’ll have dinner two nights in a row with just 35 minutes of cooking.

item.title: What's Been Cooking: January 2026
item.description: Happy New Year, everyone! 2026 was off to a busy start for us - here’s what we were up to in January.

item.title: Smoky Pomegranate Margarita
item.description: Go bold with this smoky pomegranate margarita for your next Taco Tuesday, making burritos at home, or just looking for a delicious tequila based cocktail.

item.title: 10 Minute Spicy Pizza Sauce Recipe With Calabrian Chilis
item.description: Spicy pizza sauce is the key to leveling up homemade pizza nights! Chopped Calabrian chilies and red pepper flakes bring fiery heat to a traditional tomato sauce that will ignite your tastebuds. It cooks in just 10 minutes on the stove and makes a large batch so you can enjoy spicy pizzas over and over again.

item.title: What’s Been Cooking: February 2026
item.description: Between the Super Bowl, the Winter Olympics, our 10 year dating anniversary, and Valentine’s Day, February was full of reasons to celebrate and enjoy good food!

item.title: Creamy Sun Dried Tomato Pesto Pasta With Parmesan and Basil
item.description: Make this creamy sun dried tomato pesto pasta in just 15 minutes for a flavorful weeknight dinner! It’s the perfect low effort, high reward meal.

item.title: What Is Wholesome Comfort Food?
item.description: How we use real ingredients and familiar flavors to create satisfying meals that nourish both our bodies and souls.

item.title: Spicy Chorizo Nachos With Jalapenos And Chipotle Mayo
item.description: Savory, hearty chorizo nachos with spicy jalapenos and chipotle mayo are the coziest comfort food appetizer or dinner for two! Ready in 25 minutes for a spicy date night in.
